keys.description: The legacy PreProcessOnTrg hook (ProcessPolicy.PreProcessOnTarget): ONE raw T-SQL command, run by TargetProcessHooks.RunAsync (src/SqlFlow.SqlServer/Ingestion/TargetProcessHooks.cs:17-23) as a single verbatim SqlCommand with CommandType.Text and CommandTimeout=0, on its OWN dedicated SqlConnection to the target - no parameters bound, no enclosing transaction. IngestionFlowRunner executes it as stage '2b', after source-column introspection but before the canonical staging table is rebuilt (IngestionFlowRunner.cs:255-263). On a flow's very first-ever run the target table does not exist yet, so an authored statement that touches the target must guard itself with `IF OBJECT_ID(...) IS NOT NULL` (a carried-over legacy contract, not enforced by the engine). TargetProcessHooks.ShouldRun gates execution on `hook.Trim().Length > 2` (TargetProcessHooks.cs:15) - a legacy activation threshold mirroring the old `ExecNonQuery(...)` call's guard - so a trimmed value of two characters or fewer (e.g. a stray '--' comment placeholder) is silently skipped rather than executed or flagged.
